title: Gamut and Timelapse+
tagline: Licensing for color grades, and a Lightroom to Resolve export
context: Gamut sells color-grading LUTs and bought Timelapse+. The work protected its color grades and connected Lightroom Classic to DaVinci Resolve.
delivered: An encryptor that turns grade files into protected .gamut files
Host plugins for Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve and Final Cut Pro; the Final Cut Pro plugin was built and never shipped by Gamut
For Timelapse+: an export from Lightroom Classic straight into a DaVinci Resolve project, in Lua and Python
